Title: First-Timers Meetup
Blurb: Whether this is your first, fifth, fifteenth, or fiftieth time attending MCN, all are invited to join us in welcoming the newest members of the MCN community who are attending MCN for the first time. Get loose and break some ice ahead of the evening's Ignite reception.Cash bar; complimentary light fare will be available
Location: Hyatt Regency - Prairie Kitchen and Bar
